In many communities, fishing nets are often damaged during use or after being used for extended periods. To ensure the continued availability of fish for local families, regular mending of these nets is essential. Community members, especially those with experience in fishing, play a vital role in this process. They gather to repair and reinforce nets, ensuring that the fishing industry remains sustainable and productive. This collective effort not only helps preserve local resources but also strengthens community bonds.  

P.P.S. Do not forget the volunteers.
